purpose: Retry access to the current LibreCAD candidate window after the earlier no-display preflight.

observations.result: Returned the macOS app/browser inventory; LibreCAD and FreeCAD processes were listed as running.

observations.operation: repeat candidate app attach after fresh inventory

interpretation: App inventory is available, but Computer Use could not attach to native app windows. This does not establish that the macOS login session is locked or that a specific drawing was opened. No P8-D GUI result was produced.
nextTrigger: Retry when cua.getApp can attach to the explicit LibreCAD candidate path and return a window accessibility state.
